title: The Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect at 5″: RX J1347.5-1145 imaged by ALMA
question: Can ALMA (7-m plus 12-m arrays, Band 3) image the thermal SZE of RX J1347.5-1145 at 5 arcsec resolution, and how should missing flux be corrected and the map compared with X-ray and earlier SZE data?

data.sensitivity: 0.017 mJy/beam at 5" (0.12 mK_CMB); dirty-map rms 0.012 (12-m), 0.083 (7-m) mJy/beam

what.value: Spatially resolved deprojected electron temperatures for spherical SZE model

evidence.quote: Spatially resolved and deprojected electron temperatures are taken from Table 7 of (cite: Ota08)
the peculiar velocity of this cluster $v_{\rm pec}=-1040^{+870}_{-840}$ km/s reported by (cite: Sayers16)

what.value: MUSTANG and NOBA SZE maps used for comparison

evidence.quote: comparison of the ALMA map with previous SZE observations of RX J1347.5–1145 by MUSTANG (cite: Mason10; Korngut11) and NOBA (cite: Komatsu01)
$y_{\rm   peak}=8\times10^{-4}$ as inferred from the previous SZE measurements of this cluster (cite: Komatsu01; Kitayama04)

recipe.method: Dirty images from calibrated visibilities; noise from half-split difference maps
Point-source fit in uv plane for uv>30 kλ, separately for 84-88 and 96-100 GHz, subtracted from visibilities
Multi-Scale CLEAN with scale set chosen for minimal residuals and maximal recovered flux
Chandra spectra in contour-binned regions give projected T and normalization; pseudo density and pressure
assumptions: Gas uniformly distributed over line-of-sight length L; CIE plasma; Anders & Grevesse abundances; NH=4.6e20

recipe.method: Simulate ALMA observations of pressure-map model with simobserve; derive Fourier-space correction (i) and real-space linear relation (ii)
key_parameters: y_peak=8e-4; four spectral windows 1.875 GHz each
assumptions: Relativistic SZE correction of Nozawa05 with projected temperature

recipe.method: Divide by 0.88, subtract mean at 40" from peak, convert to Δy with relativistic correction

evidence.quote: we find $F_\nu=4.16 \pm 0.03 \pm 0.25$ mJy and $3.96 \pm 0.03 \pm 0.24$ mJy at the central frequencies of 86 GHz and 98 GHz
$3.96 \pm 0.03 \pm 0.24$ mJy at the central frequencies of 86 GHz and 98 GHz, respectively
The spectral index of the source inferred from the two measurements over a narrow range between 86 GHz and 98 GHz is $-0.38 \pm 0.12$.

answer_key.quantity: SZE flux within 40" of SE peak

evidence.quote: The measured flux within a radius of $40''$ from the south-east peak is $-12.4 \pm 0.2 \pm 0.8$ mJy.
The peak value of the Compton $y$-parameter is $\Delta y = (5.9 \pm 0.4 \pm 0.8) \times 10^{-4}$

not_stated_but_needed: Exact CASA task parameters (niter, mask, spw selection) for tclean/clean
Simulation details: simobserve PWV and noise settings, exact large-scale fall-off factor shape
Contour-binning and XSPEC fit details for pseudo pressure map
Whether Band 3 7-m QA2 weights were rescaled
score_reason: Detailed recipe with parameters and public data; some simulation and X-ray details are unspecified.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA and Chandra data, detailed imaging recipe, numeric results (flux, y, c1).
